name: sistema-perfil-estudiantil
description: Afinia — Sistema Multiplataforma para la Construcción del Perfil Estudiantil Dinámico, Ingeniería en Sistemas Informáticos, Univalle.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres
scripts.db:rebuild: npm run db:reset && npm run db:wait && npm run shared:build && npm run api:migrate && npm run seed
scripts.mail:preview: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile correo up -d mailpit
scripts.test:web: npm --prefix web run build && node scripts/e2e-web.mjs
scripts.test:ai: npm --prefix api run build:e2e && node scripts/e2e-ai-provider.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && node scripts/e2e-objectives-40.mjs && node scripts/e2e-objective-5.mjs && node scripts/e2e-objective-6.mjs && node scripts/e2e-objective-7.mjs && node scripts/e2e-batch-1.mjs && node scripts/e2e-batch-2.mjs && node scripts/e2e-batch-3.mjs && node scripts/e2e-batch-4.mjs && node scripts/e2e-batch-5.mjs && node scripts/e2e-batch-6.mjs && node scripts/e2e-batch-7.mjs && node scripts/e2e-batch-8.mjs && node scripts/e2e-batch-9.mjs && node scripts/e2e-batch-10.mjs && node scripts/e2e-batch-11.mjs && node scripts/e2e-qa.mjs && node scripts/e2e-v2.mjs && npm run test:ai && npm run test:web
